newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas rises as 450 lots done in 14 trades.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas rises as 450 lots done in 14 trades.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures saw far more activity than normal on Monday when 450 lots were traded, of which 400 were done on the two-hour afternoon session.

Trades were done in four separate months, August, September, January and February. All four finished higher. Front month August last traded at 9.40 pence a therm, an increase of 0.075 pence from the settlement price on Friday.
January saw the biggest rise, up by 0.22 pence a therm to trade at 17.80 pence. It had previously traded at 17.95 pence.
The 450 lots traded were spread over 14 separate deals. The record volume is 575 lots in a single day, and on January 31, the first day of the contract, 465 lots were traded.

Although the day was far busier than normal, there were still four months with no offers posted by the close of trade. The front two months saw bid/offer spreads of 9.30/9.60 pence and 9.38/9.675 pence respectively at the close, up from settlement levels on Friday of 9.325 pence and 9.40 pence. February was offered as high as 18.10 pence by the close, up from a settlement level of 17.74 pence on Friday.
